slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that make your energy
impossible to ignore

morning sunlight

step outside within 30 minutes of waking up and let daylight hit your eyes for ten minutes. your energy for the whole day starts right here, long before your first coffee.

dancing alone

put on one song a day and dance to it alone in your room, badly and fully. people with loose, relaxed bodies walk into rooms differently, and everyone can feel it.

making things by hand

pick up something you make with your hands: pottery, knitting, woodwork. people who create things carry a calm, focused energy that people who only consume never have.

a new obsession

spend 5 minutes a day learning about something that fascinates you: black holes, ancient egypt, how bees talk. people who light up about ideas have an energy nobody can fake.
slides.texte_sophia:
a new obsession

i used to fill every spare minute with my phone. now i spend 5 minutes a day on one lesson in the Sophia app: black holes, ancient egypt. people say i light up when i talk now.

slides.texte_overlay:
early nights

go to bed at the same time every night for two weeks, even on weekends. nothing changes your face, your voice and your mood faster than finally being properly rested.
